title: Logarithmic growth of critical dimension
statement: For integers $w,s\geq0$, call $s$ a candidate at width $w$ if $1-(1-2^{-w})^s\leq 1/2$. Let $s_w$ be the greatest candidate among the integers from $0$ through $2^{w+2}$, taking $s_w=0$ if there is no candidate, and put $D_w=s_w w$. As $w\to+\infty$ through integers, $\frac{\log D_w}{D_w}$ tends to $0$.
hypotheses_covered: candidate sizes are restricted to integers from $0$ through $2^{w+2}$
